summary: Murder and abduction conviction; disputed motive based on property litigation; reliance on testimonies of PW2, PW4, PW18; High Court reversal of Trial Court's acquittal of appellants (accused nos. 6-7); Section 34 IPC applicability for common intention; circumstantial evidence including medical testimony and missing persons from residence; impugned judgment set aside on procedural grounds.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; acquittals of accused nos. 6 and 7 restored; convictions of accused nos. 1-5 overturned.
